theme_summary_ja: 1956年のスエズ危機直後のエジプト・ポートサイドを舞台に、亡くなった友人の未亡人に呼ばれてやってきたイギリス人男性タウンロウの物語。彼は頭部を負傷して記憶や知覚が曖昧になり、友人の死の真相も、自分自身の立場さえも判然としなくなっていく。混乱し漂流する主人公の姿は、スエズ危機で威信を失っていく英国そのものの姿とも重ねられる。記念すべき第1回ブッカー賞受賞作。
theme_summary_en: Set in Port Said, Egypt, in the immediate aftermath of the 1956 Suez Crisis, this is the story of Townrow, an Englishman summoned there by the widow of a deceased friend. A head injury has left him with clouded memory and perception, and he grows increasingly unable to determine either the truth of his friend's death or even his own place in events. The confused, drifting figure of the protagonist mirrors Britain's own loss of prestige and direction during the Suez Crisis. The inaugural winner of the Booker Prize.

theme_summary_ja: ロンドンに住むユダヤ人家庭を舞台に、かつて弁護士として将来を嘱望されていた長男が薬物依存に陥り、精神を病んでいく姿を描く物語。家族は彼を入院させるべきかをめぐって葛藤し、その過程で長年隠されてきた家庭内の秘密や互いへの複雑な感情が明らかになっていく。家族の愛情と支配、期待と挫折が絡み合う心理劇。
theme_summary_en: Set within a Jewish family in London, the novel follows the eldest son -- once a lawyer with a promising future -- as he succumbs to drug addiction and mental illness. His family is torn over whether to have him committed, and in the process, long-hidden secrets and tangled feelings within the household come to light. A psychological drama in which family love and control, hope and disappointment, are inextricably entwined.

theme_summary_ja: 表題作を中心に、独立直後のアフリカを舞台にした中編と、旅先での見聞を記した前後の断章から構成される連作集。表題作ではイギリス人の男女が独立したばかりの東アフリカの国を車で横断し、人種や階級によって引き裂かれた社会の緊張と暴力の予感を目の当たりにする。脱植民地化後の世界を漂う人々を通じて、「自由」ということの意味を問う作品。
notes_en: Won the Booker Prize in 1971 and the Nobel Prize in Literature in 2001. A leading example of a writer who won both the Booker Prize and the Nobel Prize.
theme_summary_en: A collection built around its title novella, framed by shorter pieces recording the author's travel observations. In the title work, an Englishman and Englishwoman drive across a newly independent East African nation and witness firsthand the tensions of a society riven by race and class, and the sense of impending violence. Through people adrift in a post-colonial world, the collection asks what "freedom" truly means.

theme_summary_ja: 20世紀初頭のヨーロッパを舞台に、放蕩者の青年Gの数々の恋愛遍歴を軸にした物語。イタリア統一運動やミラノの労働運動、第一次世界大戦前夜の社会不安といった歴史的事件が背景として織り込まれる。伝統的な小説の語りに批評的な文章や図版を組み込む実験的な手法で、身体・欲望・歴史の関係を描いた作品。
theme_summary_en: Set in early-twentieth-century Europe, the novel follows the numerous love affairs of G, a young libertine, against a backdrop of historical events -- the movement for Italian unification, labor unrest in Milan, and the social anxieties on the eve of the First World War. Through an experimental technique that interweaves conventional narrative with critical essayistic passages and illustrations, it explores the relationship between the body, desire, and history.

theme_summary_ja: 1857年のインド大反乱を題材に、架空の町クリシャンプルに置かれたイギリス人居留地が現地の反乱軍に包囲される様子を描く歴史小説。籠城が長引くにつれ物資は尽き、疫病が広がり、文明的だと自負していたイギリス人たちの秩序と体面が次第に崩れていく。大英帝国の傲慢さと、その支配が内側から瓦解していく過程を皮肉を込めて描く作品。
theme_summary_en: A historical novel set during the Indian Rebellion of 1857, depicting the siege of a British settlement in the fictional town of Krishnapur by rebel forces. As the siege drags on, supplies dwindle, disease spreads, and the order and decorum that the British residents had prided themselves on gradually collapse. A work that portrays, with biting irony, the arrogance of the British Empire and the way its rule crumbled from within.

theme_summary_ja: アパルトヘイト期の南アフリカを舞台に、週末を過ごす農場を営む裕福な白人実業家メーリングが、その土地に眠る黒人労働者の身元不明の遺体と向き合う物語。表向きの豊かな暮らしの下に、彼が見ないようにしてきた土地と人々の歴史がじわじわと浮かび上がってくる。白人による土地と支配の欺瞞を、詩的な文体で静かに暴く作品。
notes_en: 1974 was a joint award. Won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1991. A leading example of a writer who won both the Booker Prize and the Nobel Prize.
theme_summary_en: Set in South Africa during apartheid, the novel centers on Mehring, a wealthy white businessman who owns a weekend farm, and his confrontation with the unidentified body of a Black laborer buried on his land. Beneath his outwardly comfortable existence, the history of the land and its people -- a history he has long refused to see -- slowly rises to the surface. In quiet, poetic prose, the novel exposes the deceptions underlying white ownership and domination of the land.

theme_summary_ja: イングランドの海辺の保養地を舞台に、大学講師のエドウィン・フィッシャーが幼い息子の死と妻との破局を抱えて休暇に訪れる物語。滞在先で偶然にも妻の両親と再会し、過去の記憶や夫婦関係の真実が少しずつ明らかになっていく。地方都市の穏やかな日常描写を通して、喪失と悔恨に向き合う中年男性の内面を丁寧に描いた作品。
theme_summary_en: Set in an English seaside resort town, the novel follows Edwin Fisher, a university lecturer, who arrives on holiday carrying the burden of his young son's death and the collapse of his marriage. By chance, he encounters his former in-laws during his stay, and past memories and the truth about his marriage gradually come to light. Through gentle depictions of everyday provincial life, the novel carefully renders the inner life of a middle-aged man confronting loss and regret.

theme_summary_ja: 1920年代のインドで、イギリス人行政官の妻オリヴィアが現地の王侯と道ならぬ恋に落ちるいきさつと、それから半世紀後にその足跡をたどる孫娘の旅とが交互に語られる二重構造の物語。植民地時代のイギリス人とインド社会との緊張関係、そして時代を超えて反復される欲望と逸脱が主題となる。異文化との出会いが人をどう変えるかを描いた作品。
theme_summary_en: A dual-structured novel that alternates between the 1920s, when Olivia, wife of a British colonial administrator in India, falls into a forbidden love affair with a local prince, and, half a century later, her granddaughter's journey retracing her steps. Its themes are the tensions between colonial-era Britons and Indian society, and the way desire and transgression recur across generations. A work about how encounters with another culture can transform a person.

theme_summary_ja: 第二次世界大戦前後のヨークシャーの炭鉱町を舞台に、炭鉱夫の長男コリン・サヴィルの少年期から青年期までを描くビルドゥングスロマン。奨学金を得てグラマースクールに進学したことで、労働者階級の家族や地元社会から次第に疎外されていく様子が丁寧に描かれる。生まれる前に亡くなった兄の記憶に縛られながら自分の居場所を探す主人公を通して、階級と教育がもたらす断絶を浮かび上がらせる作品。
theme_summary_en: Set in a Yorkshire mining town before and after the Second World War, this bildungsroman follows Colin Saville, the eldest son of a coal miner, from boyhood into early manhood. Winning a scholarship to grammar school, he finds himself gradually estranged from his working-class family and community, a process the novel renders with great care. Bound to the memory of an elder brother who died before he was born, the protagonist searches for his own place, and through him the novel brings into focus the rift that class and education can open.

theme_summary_ja: インド独立から数十年後、帰国せずにインドの避暑地に住み続けるイギリス人退役軍人夫婦タスカーとルーシーの晩年を描く物語。かつての支配者としての誇りと、時代に取り残された寂しさを抱えながら暮らす二人の姿を通じて、大英帝国の終焉後を生きる人々の哀愁を描く。『ラージ・カルテット』の後日談として、植民地時代の記憶が薄れていく様子も映し出す作品。
theme_summary_en: Set decades after Indian independence, the novel depicts the twilight years of Tusker and Lucy, a retired British army couple who never returned home and continue to live in an Indian hill station. Through their lives -- caught between pride in their former status as rulers and the loneliness of being left behind by history -- the novel conveys the melancholy of those who lived on after the fall of the British Empire. Serving as a coda to the author's Raj Quartet, it also traces the fading of colonial-era memory.

theme_summary_ja: 成功を収めた演劇人チャールズ・アロウビーが引退後、海辺の家に隠棲し回想録を書き始めるところから始まる物語。そこで彼は少年時代の初恋の相手ハートリーと偶然再会し、彼女を取り戻そうとする執着にとらわれていく。自己愛と嫉妬、記憶の美化がもたらす滑稽さと痛ましさを、皮肉たっぷりに描いた作品。
theme_summary_en: The novel opens with Charles Arrowby, a celebrated man of the theater, retiring to a house by the sea and beginning to write his memoirs. There he happens to encounter Hartley, his first love from boyhood, and becomes gripped by an obsession to win her back. Written with abundant irony, the novel captures the comedy and the pathos that arise from self-love, jealousy, and the idealizing distortions of memory.

theme_summary_ja: 1960年代初頭、ロンドンのテムズ川に係留されたはしけ船に暮らす風変わりな住人たちの日々を描く物語。定職も定住地も持たず、川の満ち引きのように不安定な生活を送る彼らの人間関係や小さな事件をユーモアを交えて描写する。陸にも川にも完全には属さない「どっちつかず」の生き方そのものが主題となっている作品。
theme_summary_en: Set in the early 1960s, the novel depicts the daily lives of a group of eccentric residents living aboard barges moored on the Thames in London. With gentle humor, it portrays their relationships and small mishaps, their lives as unstable as the rise and fall of the tide, belonging fully to neither land nor river. The theme itself is this state of belonging to neither shore.

theme_summary_ja: ナポレオン戦争期、オーストラリアへ向かう帆船の航海を描く物語。乗客の一人である若い聖職者エドマンド・タルボットの日記を中心に、階級意識にとらわれた乗客・乗組員たちの間で一人の牧師が受ける屈辱的な仕打ちが描かれる。閉ざされた船という空間での身分制度と残酷さを通じて、人間の尊厳が失われていく様を描いた、三部作「地の果て」の第一作。
notes_en: The author, William Golding, won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1983 (author_id on the Nobel side: william-golding).
theme_summary_en: Set during the Napoleonic Wars, the novel recounts a sailing voyage bound for Australia. Centered on the diary of Edmund Talbot, a young clergyman among the passengers, it depicts the humiliating treatment inflicted on a chaplain by class-obsessed passengers and crew alike. Through the rigid hierarchies and cruelty enacted within the closed world of the ship, the novel traces the erosion of human dignity. The first volume of the trilogy To the Ends of the Earth.

author_ja: サルマン・ラシュディ

jp_translation.publisher: 早川書房(のち岩波文庫)

theme_summary_ja: 1947年8月15日、インド独立の瞬間に生まれた主人公サリームと、同じ日に生まれた「真夜中の子供たち」千人以上が特殊な力を持つという設定の物語。サリームの数奇な人生を通して、インド・パキスタン分離独立からその後数十年の激動の歴史が語り直される。マジックリアリズムの手法で、個人の運命と国家の運命を重ね合わせて描いた代表作。
theme_summary_en: The protagonist, Saleem, is born at the exact moment of Indian independence on August 15, 1947, along with more than a thousand other "midnight's children," all of whom are gifted with extraordinary powers. Through Saleem's extraordinary life, the tumultuous history of the decades following the Partition of India and Pakistan is retold. Using the techniques of magical realism, this landmark novel maps the fate of an individual onto the fate of a nation.

author_ja: トマス・キニーリー
work_ja: シンドラーの箱舟(シンドラーのリスト)
theme_summary_ja: 第二次世界大戦下のナチス占領下ポーランドを舞台に、実業家オスカー・シンドラーがユダヤ人労働者を自らの工場で雇用することで、ホロコーストから1000人以上の命を救った実話に基づく物語。当初は戦争で利益を得ようとしていた人物が、次第に危険を冒して人々を守る側へと変わっていく過程を描く。事実の調査に基づくノンフィクション・ノベルとして書かれている作品。
theme_summary_en: Set in Nazi-occupied Poland during the Second World War, this is a novel based on the true story of the businessman Oscar Schindler, who saved more than a thousand Jewish lives from the Holocaust by employing them as laborers in his factory. It traces his transformation from a man initially seeking to profit from the war into someone willing to risk everything to protect others. Written as a nonfiction novel grounded in factual research.

theme_summary_ja: 内戦状態にある近未来の南アフリカを思わせる国を舞台に、口唇裂を持つ庭師マイケルKが、病気の母親を故郷へ連れて行こうと荒廃した国土を旅する物語。母の死後も一人で放浪を続け、収容所に入れられても最低限の言葉と行動で自らの自由な生き方を守ろうとする。国家や制度の暴力に対して寡黙な抵抗を貫く一人の人間を描いた作品。
notes_en: Won the Booker Prize twice, in 1983 and 1999, and also won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 2003. A leading example of a writer who won both the Booker Prize and the Nobel Prize.
theme_summary_en: A novel set against the backdrop of civil war in a near-future South Africa, following Michael K, a simple-minded gardener of mixed race, as he tries to take his dying mother back to her rural birthplace. Stripped of nearly everything by war and bureaucracy, Michael K quietly insists on his own way of living and dying, cultivating a small patch of earth in an almost wordless assertion of freedom and dignity. Coetzee's spare, allegorical prose transforms one man's flight from the machinery of the state into a profound meditation on autonomy, invisibility, and survival.

theme_summary_ja: スイスの湖畔にあるホテルに逗留する中年の女性小説家イーディスの数日間を描く物語。彼女はロンドンでのある出来事の後、友人たちに促されてこの地に身を隠しており、滞在客たちの人間模様を観察しながら自分自身の結婚観や生き方を見つめ直していく。恋愛や結婚に対する社会の期待と、一人の女性の内面の自立との緊張関係を静かに描いた作品。
theme_summary_en: The novel depicts several days in the life of Edith, a middle-aged novelist staying at a hotel by a Swiss lake. Following some unnamed incident in London, she has retreated there at her friends' urging, and as she observes the other guests, she reexamines her own views on marriage and on how she wishes to live. A quiet portrayal of the tension between society's expectations for love and marriage and one woman's inner independence.

theme_summary_ja: ニュージーランドの海辺の塔に一人で暮らす画家ケレウィンと、言葉を話せない少年サイモン、そして少年を養育するマオリの男ジョーの三人の関係を描く物語。サイモンへの虐待という重い現実に直面しながらも、三人はそれぞれの孤独や暴力性を抱えたまま痛みを伴う絆を築いていく。マオリの神話や言語を織り込みながら、傷ついた者同士がつながっていく可能性を描いた作品。
theme_summary_en: A novel centered on the relationship among three figures: Kerewin, a painter living alone in a tower by the New Zealand coast; Simon, a mute boy; and Joe, the Maori man raising him. Confronting the grim reality of abuse suffered by Simon, the three of them, each carrying their own loneliness and capacity for violence, forge a painful but genuine bond. Weaving in Maori myth and language, the novel explores the possibility of connection among wounded people.

theme_summary_ja: ウェールズの町で年老いた友人たちが酒場やパブで日々を過ごしている中に、かつてこの町で人気者だった詩人アリスとその妻ロージーが移り住んでくる物語。ロージーは若い頃、老友人たちの多くと関係を持っていたため、その帰還が過去の恋愛や確執を次々と呼び覚ましていく。老いや飲酒、失われた青春への未練をユーモラスかつ辛辣に描いた作品。
theme_summary_en: In a Welsh town where a circle of aging friends while away their days in bars and pubs, the poet Alun, once the town's most popular figure, moves back with his wife Rhiannon. Since Rhiannon had affairs with many of the old friends in her youth, her return stirs up long-buried romances and rivalries one after another. A work that depicts old age, drink, and unresolved longing for a lost youth with both humor and biting wit.

theme_summary_ja: 末期の病で入院している老女性歴史家クローディアが、病床で自らの人生を回想する物語。彼女は第二次世界大戦中のエジプトで、戦場に赴く前の若い戦車兵と激しい恋に落ちた過去を持ち、その記憶が現在の孤独と重ね合わされていく。同じ出来事を複数の登場人物の視点から語り直す構成を通じて、記憶や歴史の主観性を描いた作品。
theme_summary_en: Claudia, an elderly historian dying in a hospital bed, looks back over her life. During the Second World War in Egypt, she had fallen into a passionate love affair with a young tank officer before he went off to the front, and this memory is layered against her present solitude. Through a structure that retells the same events from multiple characters' points of view, the novel explores the subjectivity of memory and history.

author_ja: ピーター・ケアリー

theme_summary_ja: 19世紀のイングランドとオーストラリアを舞台に、賭け事にのめり込む聖職者オスカーと、ガラス工場を営む型破りな女性実業家ルシンダの奇妙な絆を描く物語。二人はある賭けをきっかけに、内陸の奥地の教会までガラス製の教会堂を運ぶという無謀な計画に挑むことになる。信仰と運、狂気すれすれの情熱が絡み合う、ビクトリア朝を舞台にした奇想小説。
notes_en: The author, Peter Carey, won the Booker Prize twice, in 1988 and 2001.
theme_summary_en: A sweeping, unconventional love story set in nineteenth-century Australia, following the eccentric clergyman Oscar Hopkins and the independent-minded glass heiress Lucinda Leplastrier, both compulsive gamblers drawn together by a shared, almost spiritual devotion to risk. Their improbable wager to transport a glass church across the outback becomes an audacious, doomed act of faith and love. Carey blends dark comedy, historical pastiche, and tragedy to explore obsession, colonial ambition, and the strange logic of chance.

author_ja: カズオ・イシグロ

jp_translation.publisher: 早川書房(ハヤカワepi文庫)

notes: 2017年にノーベル文学賞を受賞。ブッカー賞・ノーベル賞双方を受けた代表例
theme_summary_ja: イギリスの名家に長年仕えてきた老執事スティーブンスが、かつての同僚ミス・ケントンを訪ねる短い旅の道中で、自らの人生を振り返る物語。彼は主人であったダーリントン卿への忠誠を優先し、ミス・ケントンへの想いや主人の政治的な誤りに目をつぶってきたことに、旅の終わりに気づいていく。職務への忠実さと引き換えに見過ごしてきた感情や機会を、静かな筆致で描いた作品。
notes_en: Won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 2017. A leading example of a writer who won both the Booker Prize and the Nobel Prize.
theme_summary_en: Stevens, an aging butler who has spent his life in service to a distinguished English household, sets out on a short journey to visit a former colleague, Miss Kenton, and along the way looks back over his life. By journey's end, he comes to recognize that in prioritizing his loyalty to his former employer, Lord Darlington, he turned a blind eye both to his feelings for Miss Kenton and to his master's political errors. A quietly written novel about the feelings and opportunities sacrificed in the name of professional duty.

author_ja: A・S・バイアット

jp_translation.translator: 栗原行雄(訳詩:大原千佳子)

theme_summary_ja: 現代の文学研究者二人が、19世紀の架空の詩人二人の間に秘められた恋愛関係を示す手紙を発見し、その真相を追う物語。過去の詩人たちの往復書簡や詩作品と、それを追う現代の研究者たちの人間関係とが交互に語られる。文学研究という営みそのものをテーマにしながら、恋愛小説と推理小説の要素を兼ね備えた作品。
theme_summary_en: Two present-day literary scholars discover letters hinting at a secret love affair between two fictional nineteenth-century poets, and set out to uncover the truth. The novel alternates between the correspondence and poetry of the Victorian-era poets and the entangled relationships of the modern researchers pursuing their story. A work concerned with the practice of literary scholarship itself while combining elements of both romance and detective fiction.

author_ja: ベン・オクリ
country: イギリス/ナイジェリア
theme_summary_ja: ナイジェリアを舞台に、生と死のはざまを行き来する霊的な子供とされる少年アザロの物語。アザロは貧しい家庭に生まれながらも精霊たちの世界からこの世にとどまることを選び、独立前後の社会の混乱や貧困、政治的暴力を目の当たりにする。アフリカの精霊信仰とマジックリアリズムを融合させ、現実と幻想が絶えず交錯する語りで社会の姿を描いた作品。
theme_summary_en: Set in Nigeria, the novel follows Azaro, a boy believed to be an "abiku," a spirit-child who moves between the realms of life and death. Born into poverty, Azaro chooses to remain in the world of the living rather than return to the spirit realm, and bears witness to the social upheaval, poverty, and political violence surrounding independence. Fusing African spiritual belief with magical realism, the novel portrays society through a narrative in which the real and the fantastical constantly intermingle.

author_ja: マイケル・オンダーチェ
theme_summary_ja: 第二次世界大戦末期、イタリアの荒廃した邸宅を舞台に、全身に大やけどを負い身元不明となった「イギリス人の患者」と、彼を看護するカナダ人看護師、盗みを働くスパイ崩れの男、爆弾処理の技師という四人が寄り添って暮らす物語。患者の記憶が断片的に語られるにつれ、彼が北アフリカの砂漠でかつて経験した禁じられた恋と裏切りが明らかになっていく。国境や国籍を超えた愛と喪失、戦争の傷跡を描いた作品。
theme_summary_en: In the closing days of the Second World War, four people take shelter together in a ruined Italian villa: the "English patient," burned beyond recognition and identity; the Canadian nurse who cares for him; a former spy turned thief; and a bomb-disposal expert. As the patient's memories emerge in fragments, they reveal a forbidden love and an act of betrayal he once experienced in the deserts of North Africa. A novel of love and loss that transcends borders and nationality, and of the scars war leaves behind.

theme_summary_ja: 18世紀、イギリスの商船が奴隷貿易のためにアフリカへ向かい、やがて反乱を起こして辿り着いた先で独自の共同体を築こうとする物語。船主の息子と船医という対照的な二人の視点を通じて、利益を追い求める資本の論理と、人間の尊厳を守ろうとする理想主義とがぶつかり合う。大西洋奴隷貿易という歴史の暗部を正面から描いた大作。
theme_summary_en: Set in the eighteenth century, the novel follows a British merchant ship bound for Africa to take on a cargo of slaves, which later becomes the site of a mutiny, after which the survivors attempt to build their own independent community. Through the contrasting viewpoints of the ship-owner's son and the ship's surgeon, the novel stages a collision between the logic of profit-seeking capital and an idealism devoted to preserving human dignity. A sweeping work that confronts head-on the dark history of the transatlantic slave trade.

author_ja: ロディ・ドイル

theme_summary_ja: 1960年代のダブリン郊外を舞台に、10歳の少年パディ・クラークの目を通して語られる物語。友人たちとの悪ふざけや喧嘩といった無邪気な日常の合間に、次第に両親の不仲が深刻化し、家庭が壊れていく気配が忍び寄る。子供特有の語り口で家庭崩壊という重いテーマをすくい上げた作品。
theme_summary_en: Set in a Dublin suburb in the 1960s, the story is told through the eyes of ten-year-old Paddy Clarke. Amid the innocent pranks and squabbles of daily life with his friends, the growing discord between his parents and the creeping sense of a family coming apart intrude ever more insistently. A novel that captures the weighty theme of family breakdown through a distinctly childlike narrative voice.

theme_summary_ja: グラスゴーに暮らす失業中の男サミーが、酒に酔って警察に暴行を受けた末、目が見えなくなってしまうところから始まる物語。視力を失った彼は周囲の助けを頼りながらも意地を張って一人で街をさまよい歩き、行方不明になった恋人を探そうとする。スコットランド訛りの内的独白と口語表現を全編で用い、社会の底辺に生きる人間の怒りと生命力を描いた作品。
theme_summary_en: The novel opens as Sammy, an unemployed man in Glasgow, is beaten by police while drunk and loses his sight as a result. Now blind, he stubbornly refuses much of the help offered to him and wanders the city alone in search of his missing girlfriend. Written throughout in Scottish-accented interior monologue and vernacular speech, the novel captures the rage and resilience of a man living at the bottom of society.

author_ja: パット・バーカー

jp_translation.note: 邦訳は確認できず(2026年時点)

theme_summary_ja: 第一次世界大戦末期、戦争神経症の治療にあたる精神科医リヴァーズと、前線に戻る若い将校ビリー・プライアーの物語が交互に語られる。リヴァーズは自らがかつて調査したメラネシアの部族の記憶を通じて文明と暴力について思いを巡らせ、プライアーは仲間たちと共に西部戦線での最後の戦いに向かう。三部作「再生」の完結編として、戦争が人間の精神に残す傷を描いた作品。
theme_summary_en: Set in the final months of the First World War, the novel alternates between the stories of Dr. Rivers, a psychiatrist treating soldiers for shell shock, and Billy Prior, a young officer returning to the front. Rivers reflects on civilization and violence through memories of his earlier anthropological fieldwork among a Melanesian tribe, while Prior heads with his comrades toward one final battle on the Western Front. As the concluding volume of the Regeneration trilogy, the novel depicts the wounds that war leaves on the human psyche.

theme_summary_ja: ロンドンの精肉店主だった男の遺言に従い、彼の遺灰を海に撒くため、旧友たちと息子が車で旅に出る一日を描く物語。旅の道中、それぞれの登場人物の視点から語られる回想を通じて、亡くなった友人との長年の付き合いや隠されていた秘密や後悔が少しずつ明らかになっていく。労働者階級の男たちの友情と喪失を、複数の声を重ねる手法で描いた作品。
theme_summary_en: In accordance with the last wishes of a London butcher, his old friends and his son set out on a single-day car journey to scatter his ashes at sea. Along the way, through recollections narrated from each character's own point of view, decades of friendship with the dead man, along with long-hidden secrets and regrets, are gradually revealed. A novel about friendship and loss among working-class men, told through a chorus of overlapping voices.

author_ja: アルンダティ・ロイ
theme_summary_ja: 1960年代のインド・ケーララ州を舞台に、双子の兄妹エスタとラヘルの幼少期と、それから20年余り後の再会を描く物語。カースト制度の下で禁じられた恋に落ちた母親と、身分の異なる男との関係が、家族に取り返しのつかない悲劇をもたらしていく。カーストや因習が「小さきもの」である子供たちの人生を狂わせていく様を、詩的な文体で描いた作品。
theme_summary_en: Set in Kerala, India, in the 1960s, the novel depicts the childhood of fraternal twins Estha and Rahel, and their reunion more than twenty years later. Their mother's forbidden love affair, across caste lines, with a man of lower social standing brings irreversible tragedy upon the family. Written in poetic prose, the novel traces how caste and convention derail the lives of the "small things" -- the children caught in their wake.

author_ja: イアン・マキューアン
theme_summary_ja: かつての恋人を共通に持つ二人の中年男性、作曲家と新聞編集長が、その女性の葬儀で再会するところから始まる物語。互いに自らの信念や欲望を優先するあまり、友情や誠実さを裏切っていく皮肉な成り行きが描かれる。安楽死の約束をめぐる滑稽で皮肉な結末に至るまで、現代社会に生きる知識人たちの虚栄と道徳的な妥協を風刺した作品。
theme_summary_en: The novel begins as two middle-aged men, a composer and a newspaper editor who once shared the same lover, reunite at her funeral. Each prioritizing his own convictions and desires above all else, they end up betraying friendship and integrity in a series of ironic turns. Building to a darkly comic and ironic resolution involving a pact of euthanasia, the novel satirizes the vanity and moral compromise of contemporary intellectuals.

author_ja: J・M・クッツェー

jp_translation.publisher: 早川書房(ハヤカワepi文庫)

notes: 1983年・1999年にブッカー賞を2度受賞。2003年にノーベル文学賞も受賞。ブッカー賞・ノーベル賞双方を受けた代表例
theme_summary_ja: アパルトヘイト後の南アフリカを舞台に、大学教授デイヴィッド・ルーリーが教え子との不適切な関係によって職を追われ、田舎で農場を営む娘のもとに身を寄せる物語。そこで娘が受ける暴力的な事件に直面し、変わりゆく南アフリカ社会における力関係や贖罪の意味を突きつけられていく。個人の失墜と国家の転換期とを重ね合わせて描いた作品。
notes_en: Won the Booker Prize twice, in 1983 and 1999, and also won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 2003. A leading example of a writer who won both the Booker Prize and the Nobel Prize.
theme_summary_en: Set in post-apartheid South Africa, the novel follows David Lurie, a university professor forced out of his position over an improper relationship with a student, who takes refuge with his daughter on her rural farm. There, confronted with a violent attack against her, he is forced to reckon with the shifting power dynamics of a changing South Africa and with the meaning of atonement. A work that maps one man's personal downfall onto a nation's moment of transition.

author_ja: マーガレット・アトウッド
theme_summary_ja: 年老いた女性アイリスが、自殺した妹の遺した謎めいた小説をめぐって、自らの一族の秘められた過去を語り直す物語。作中作として恋人同士が語り合うSF風の物語が挿入され、複数の層が絡み合いながら姉妹の人生の真実が明らかになっていく。カナダの裕福な一族の没落と、女性たちが強いられてきた沈黙を描いた作品。
theme_summary_en: A multi-layered narrative centered on Iris Chase, an elderly woman looking back on her privileged but tragedy-marked life in early-to-mid twentieth-century Canada, interwoven with a pulp science-fiction story supposedly written by her late sister Laura. As the layers of fiction within fiction unfold, long-buried family secrets, betrayals, and the truth behind Laura's death gradually come to light. Atwood uses her signature structural ingenuity to examine memory, storytelling, and the hidden costs borne by women in a world of industrial-family power and silence.

theme_summary_ja: 19世紀オーストラリアの実在の無法者ネッド・ケリーが、自らの半生を娘に向けて書き残すという体裁で語られる物語。貧しいアイルランド系入植者の家に生まれ、権力者や警察からの不当な扱いに追い詰められていく中で、次第に無法者としての道を歩んでいく過程が描かれる。誤った綴りや独特の語り口を用いることで、実在の伝説的犯罪者に生々しい人間性を与えた作品。
notes_en: The author, Peter Carey, won the Booker Prize twice, in 1988 and 2001.
theme_summary_en: Presented as a memoir written by the real-life nineteenth-century Australian outlaw Ned Kelly for his daughter, the novel traces his path from a childhood born into poverty as the son of Irish settlers, hounded by the authorities and the police, into a life as an outlaw. Through deliberately misspelled prose and a distinctive vernacular voice, the novel gives raw, human dimension to a real and legendary criminal.

author_ja: ヤン・マーテル
theme_summary_ja: インドの動物園を営む家族の息子パイが、家族と共に船でカナダへ移住する途中で難破し、救命ボートでベンガルトラと二人きりで太平洋を漂流する物語。生き延びるための知恵と信仰心を頼りに、猛獣と共存しながら227日間を過ごす体験が描かれる。物語の結末で語られるもう一つの「別の話」が、物語ることの意味そのものを問いかける作品。
theme_summary_en: Pi, the son of a family that runs a zoo in India, is shipwrecked while emigrating with his family to Canada, and finds himself adrift on the Pacific Ocean in a lifeboat with a Bengal tiger as his only companion. Relying on his ingenuity and his faith to survive, he spends two hundred and twenty-seven days coexisting with the fearsome animal. The "other story" revealed at the novel's end raises questions about the very meaning and purpose of storytelling itself.

theme_summary_ja: アメリカ・テキサスの田舎町で起きた学校銃乱射事件の後、真犯人でないにもかかわらず疑いをかけられた15歳の少年ヴァーノンが、メディアと司法制度に翻弄されていく物語。冤罪と死刑制度、そしてスキャンダルを娯楽として消費するテレビ社会を、ブラックユーモアを交えて痛烈に風刺する。アメリカ的な過剰さを外部の視点から戯画化した作品。
theme_summary_en: After a school shooting in a small Texas town, fifteen-year-old Vernon, though innocent, comes under suspicion and finds himself swept up and abused by the media and the justice system. With dark humor, the novel delivers a savage satire of wrongful conviction, capital punishment, and a television culture that consumes scandal as entertainment. A work that caricatures American excess from an outsider's vantage point.

theme_summary_ja: 1980年代、サッチャー政権下のロンドンを舞台に、裕福な保守党議員一家に居候する青年ニックの物語。ニックは階級の異なる世界に憧れながら、同性愛者としての秘めた欲望と上流社会への羨望との間で揺れ動く。エイズの流行が影を落とし始めた時代の空気の中で、美と欲望、そして階級社会の残酷さを描いた作品。
theme_summary_en: Set in London in the 1980s under the Thatcher government, the novel follows Nick, a young man lodging with the wealthy family of a Conservative MP. Drawn to a world of privilege far removed from his own, Nick is torn between his secret desires as a gay man and his longing to belong to high society. Set against the darkening atmosphere of the emerging AIDS epidemic, the novel explores beauty, desire, and the cruelty of a class-bound society.

theme_summary_ja: 妻を亡くした美術史家マックスが、幼少期に夏を過ごした海辺の町に戻り、そこで出会ったある家族との記憶を辿る物語。子供時代に淡い憧れを抱いた同年代の少女とその双子の兄、そして彼らの母親との交流の記憶が、妻の死という現在の喪失と重ね合わされていく。時を超えた記憶と喪失の感覚を、詩的な文体で描いた作品。
theme_summary_en: Max, an art historian who has recently lost his wife, returns to the seaside town where he spent his boyhood summers and revisits his memories of a family he came to know there. The memories of a girl his own age for whom he once felt a faint boyhood longing, her twin brother, and their mother are layered against the present loss of his wife's death. Written in poetic prose, the novel captures a sense of memory and loss that transcends time.

theme_summary_ja: 1980年代、インド北東部ヒマラヤ山中の町を舞台に、引退した判事とその孤児の孫娘サイ、そしてその家の料理人の物語が、ニューヨークで不法移民として働く料理人の息子の物語と並行して語られる。地元で高まるネパール系住民の独立運動の緊張と、グローバル化の中で引き裂かれる人々の暮らしとが重ね合わされる。植民地支配の遺産と現代の格差社会とを結びつけて描いた作品。
theme_summary_en: Set in a Himalayan hill town in northeastern India in the 1980s, the novel follows a retired judge, his orphaned granddaughter Sai, and their cook, in a narrative that runs parallel to the story of the cook's son working as an undocumented immigrant in New York City. The rising tensions of a local Nepali independence movement are set alongside the lives of people torn apart by globalization. A work that links the legacy of colonial rule to the inequities of the contemporary global economy.

theme_summary_ja: 兄の自殺の知らせを受けたヴェロニカが、アイルランドの大家族の葬儀のために親族が集まる中で、自らの子供時代の記憶を辿り直す物語。祖母の家で過ごした日々の記憶を掘り起こすうちに、兄が幼い頃に受けていたある出来事の記憶が浮かび上がってくる。家族という共同体が抱える沈黙と、その中に埋もれていた痛みを描いた作品。
theme_summary_en: Upon receiving news of her brother's suicide, Veronica retraces the memories of her childhood as an extended Irish family gathers for his funeral. As she excavates memories of days spent at their grandmother's house, a suppressed memory of something that happened to her brother as a child rises to the surface. A novel about the silences a family harbors, and the pain buried within them.

theme_summary_ja: インドの貧しい村出身の運転手バルラムが、雇い主である裕福な一家のもとで働きながら、成り上がりのために殺人という手段に訴えるまでを、中国の首相に宛てた手紙の形式で語る物語。カースト制度や貧富の格差、汚職がはびこる現代インド社会を、主人公自身の露悪的でユーモラスな語り口で描き出す。経済成長するインドの光と影を鋭く風刺した作品。
theme_summary_en: Written in the form of a series of letters addressed to the Chinese premier, the novel is narrated by Balram, a driver from a poor Indian village, who recounts how his employment by a wealthy family eventually leads him to commit murder in his drive to rise in the world. In his own cynically comic and self-deprecating voice, Balram lays bare a contemporary India riddled with caste hierarchy, economic inequality, and corruption. A sharp satire of the light and shadow cast by India's economic growth.

theme_summary_ja: 16世紀イングランド、ヘンリー8世に仕える下層階級出身の廷臣トマス・クロムウェルの視点から、国王の離婚問題とそれに伴う宗教改革の激動を描く歴史小説。鍛冶屋の息子から国王の側近にまで上り詰めたクロムウェルの狡猾さと有能さ、そして彼を取り巻く宮廷の権力闘争が緻密に描かれる。よく知られた歴史的事件を、これまで悪役視されてきた人物の内面から捉え直した三部作の第一作。
theme_summary_en: The first volume of Mantel's trilogy reimagining the rise of Thomas Cromwell, a blacksmith's son who becomes the indispensable, endlessly resourceful fixer at the court of Henry VIII during the king's break with Rome and his pursuit of Anne Boleyn. Rendered in vivid, present-tense prose that places the reader inside Cromwell's calculating and surprisingly humane mind, the novel recasts a figure long cast as a villain of Tudor history as a complex, self-made man navigating a treacherous world of power, faith, and ambition.

theme_summary_ja: ロンドンに暮らす非ユダヤ人の男が、友人でユダヤ人のフィンクラーや恩師との交流を通じて、ユダヤ人であることの意味やユダヤ人への憧れに取り憑かれていく物語。喪失や老いをめぐる登場人物たちのやり取りを通じて、現代イギリス社会における反ユダヤ主義や民族的アイデンティティの複雑さがユーモラスに描かれる。友情と喪失、アイデンティティの葛藤を描いた作品。
theme_summary_en: A non-Jewish man living in London becomes fixated on the meaning of Jewishness and his own envy of it through his relationships with his Jewish friend Finkler and their former teacher. Through the characters' exchanges about loss and aging, the novel portrays, with considerable humor, the complexities of antisemitism and ethnic identity in contemporary British society. A work about friendship, loss, and the struggle over identity.

author_ja: ジュリアン・バーンズ

jp_translation.publisher: 新潮社(新潮クレスト・ブックス)

theme_summary_ja: 定年後の穏やかな生活を送る初老の男トニーが、若い頃の恋人の母親から思いがけない遺贈を受けたことをきっかけに、大学時代に自殺した親友エイドリアンをめぐる過去の記憶を辿り直す物語。自分に都合よく編集していた若い頃の記憶が、新たな事実によって次々と覆されていく。記憶の不確かさと、若い頃の行いが後年になって重い意味を持つ様を描いた作品。
theme_summary_en: Tony, an elderly man leading a quiet life in retirement, receives an unexpected bequest from the mother of a girlfriend he had in his youth, prompting him to revisit his memories of his university friend Adrian, who took his own life decades before. The memories of his youth, which he had unconsciously edited to flatter himself, are overturned one by one as new facts emerge. A novel about the unreliability of memory, and the way actions from one's youth can come to bear a heavy weight in later life.

author_ja: ヒラリー・マンテル
notes: 著者ヒラリー・マンテルは2009年・2012年にブッカー賞を2度受賞(ウルフ・ホール三部作)
theme_summary_ja: 『ウルフ・ホール』に続く三部作の第二作で、トマス・クロムウェルが王妃アン・ブーリンの失脚と処刑を主導していく過程を描く歴史小説。ヘンリー8世の寵愛が新たな女性ジェイン・シーモアへと移る中、クロムウェルはかつての盟友であったアンとその周辺の廷臣たちを陥れる策略を巡らせる。権力の座にある者の非情さと、歴史の転換点における個人の選択を描いた作品。
notes_en: The author, Hilary Mantel, won the Booker Prize twice, in 2009 and 2012 (the Wolf Hall trilogy).
theme_summary_en: The second novel in the trilogy that began with Wolf Hall, this historical novel follows Thomas Cromwell as he engineers the downfall and execution of Queen Anne Boleyn. As Henry VIII's affections shift to Jane Seymour, Cromwell schemes to bring down Anne and the courtiers around her -- men who had once been his allies. A work depicting the ruthlessness demanded of those who hold power, and the choices an individual makes at a historical turning point.

author_ja: エレノア・キャトン
theme_summary_ja: 1866年、ゴールドラッシュに沸くニュージーランドの港町を舞台に、失踪した富豪、娼婦、身元不明の死体をめぐる謎に、12人の男たちが偶然一堂に会したことから巻き込まれていく物語。西洋占星術の構造を模した精緻な構成のもと、それぞれの登場人物の視点から事件の断片が少しずつ組み合わさっていく。金鉱をめぐる欲望と偶然が絡み合う、大がかりな仕掛けを持つ推理小説。
theme_summary_en: Set in a gold-rush port town in New Zealand in 1866, the novel follows twelve men who are drawn, through pure chance, into a mystery surrounding a missing wealthy man, a prostitute, and an unidentified corpse. Built on an elaborate structure modeled on Western astrology, the novel assembles the fragments of the case piece by piece through each character's individual point of view. An intricately engineered mystery novel in which desire and chance intertwine around a gold-mining fortune.

author_ja: リチャード・フラナガン
work_original: The Narrow Road to the Deep North
theme_summary_ja: 第二次世界大戦中、日本軍の捕虜となったオーストラリア人軍医が、泰緬鉄道の建設現場で仲間の捕虜たちと共に極限状態を強いられる物語。戦後、戦争の英雄として讃えられながらも、戦時中に叶わなかった禁じられた恋の記憶に苛まれ続ける彼の人生が描かれる。松尾芭蕉の紀行文から題名を得て、戦争の暴力と生き延びた者の罪悪感を描いた作品。
theme_summary_en: During the Second World War, an Australian army doctor taken prisoner by Japanese forces is forced, along with his fellow POWs, to endure extreme conditions building the Thailand-Burma "Death Railway." After the war, though hailed as a hero, he continues to be haunted for the rest of his life by the memory of a forbidden love affair left unresolved by the war. Taking its title from a travel narrative by the Japanese poet Matsuo Basho, the novel depicts the violence of war and the guilt of those who survive it.

theme_summary_ja: 1976年にジャマイカで起きたボブ・マーリー暗殺未遂事件を題材に、ギャング、CIA工作員、ジャーナリスト、殺し屋など多数の人物の視点から、キングストンの暴力とその後数十年にわたる余波を描く物語。実在の事件を下敷きにしながらも、架空の登場人物たちを通じて冷戦下の中南米における麻薬と政治の絡み合いを描き出す。複数の声が交錯する群像劇として、暴力の連鎖を描いた作品。
theme_summary_en: Taking as its basis the 1976 attempted assassination of Bob Marley in Jamaica, the novel depicts the violence of Kingston and its decades-long aftermath through the voices of a huge cast of characters -- gang members, a CIA operative, journalists, hitmen, and more. Grounded in a real event, it uses invented characters to portray the intertwining of drugs and politics across Cold War-era Latin America and the Caribbean. An ensemble novel of interwoven voices depicting a chain reaction of violence.

theme_summary_ja: ロサンゼルス郊外の黒人居住地区で育った主人公が、地図から消えてしまった故郷の町を「復活」させるため、あえて自ら奴隷を所有し、学校で人種隔離を再導入するという突飛な計画を実行し、最高裁判所で裁かれる物語。アメリカにおける人種、階級、そして「ポスト人種社会」という建前を、過激な風刺とブラックユーモアでえぐり出す。タブーに正面から切り込んだ諷刺小説。
theme_summary_en: The protagonist, raised in a predominantly Black neighborhood on the outskirts of Los Angeles, sets out on an outrageous scheme to "resurrect" his hometown, which has literally been erased from the map, by voluntarily owning a slave and reinstating segregation at the local school -- a plan that lands him before the Supreme Court. With savage satire and dark humor, the novel excavates race, class, and the pretense of a "post-racial society" in America. A satirical novel that confronts taboo head-on.

author_ja: ジョージ・ソーンダーズ
work_ja: リンカーンとさまよえる霊魂たち

jp_translation.title_ja: リンカーンとさまよえる霊魂たち

theme_summary_ja: 南北戦争中、幼い息子ウィリーを亡くしたリンカーン大統領が夜な夜な墓地を訪れて遺体を抱いたという実話をもとに、その夜の墓地にとどまり続ける幽霊たちの視点から語られる物語。成仏できずにいる霊たちが、悲嘆に暮れる大統領と幼い息子の魂に働きかけようとする様子が、多声的な独白とコラージュ形式で描かれる。死者と生者の境目「バルド」を舞台に、喪失と手放すことの意味を問う実験的な作品。
theme_summary_en: Based on the true story of President Lincoln, who, grieving the death of his young son Willie during the Civil War, is said to have visited the cemetery night after night and held his son's body, the novel is narrated by the ghosts who remain trapped in that graveyard. Unable to move on to the next world, these spirits attempt to reach both the grieving president and the soul of his young son, in a narrative built from a chorus of voices and collage-like fragments. Set in the "bardo," the liminal space between life and death, this experimental work asks what it means to lose someone, and to let go.

author_ja: アンナ・バーンズ
country: イギリス(北アイルランド)

theme_summary_ja: 北アイルランド紛争下の名指しされない街を舞台に、18歳の女性「ミドル・シスター」が、地域で権力を持つ年上の男「ミルクマン」につきまとわれる物語。噂と監視が支配する閉塞的な共同体の中で、本人の意思に関わらず醜聞の対象にされていく主人公の恐怖と孤立が、独特の語り口で描かれる。名前を持たない登場人物たちを通して、紛争下の集団心理と女性への抑圧を描いた作品。
theme_summary_en: Set in an unnamed city during the Troubles in Northern Ireland, the novel follows an eighteen-year-old woman referred to only as "middle sister," who becomes the target of an older, locally powerful man known as "the milkman." Told in a highly distinctive voice, the novel captures the fear and isolation of a protagonist who becomes an object of scandal against her will, within a claustrophobic community ruled by rumor and surveillance. By leaving its characters unnamed, the novel depicts the collective psychology of a community under conflict and the oppression of women within it.

author_ja: マーガレット・アトウッド
theme_summary_ja: 『侍女の物語』の続編で、ギレアデ共和国の司令官夫人であり体制の中枢にいる女性、そしてカナダとギレアデでそれぞれ育った二人の若い女性という三者の証言を通じて、独裁体制の内部崩壊への道筋を描く物語。抑圧する側にいた女性の視点を加えることで、体制を支える権力構造がより多角的に描かれる。前作から十数年後を舞台にした、抵抗と体制転覆の物語。
theme_summary_en: A sequel to The Handmaid's Tale, the novel traces the path toward the internal collapse of the totalitarian Republic of Gilead through the testimony of three women: a Commander's wife at the very center of the regime, and two young women, one raised in Gilead and one in Canada. By including the perspective of a woman who has been complicit in the system of oppression, the novel offers a more multifaceted view of the power structures sustaining the regime. Set more than a decade after its predecessor, it is a story of resistance and the overthrow of a regime.

author_ja: バーナディン・エヴァリスト
theme_summary_ja: イギリスに生きる12人の黒人女性・非白人女性たちの人生を、それぞれ独立した章でつなぎ合わせた群像小説。世代も性的指向も職業も異なる女性たちの物語が、家族関係や友人関係を通じて緩やかに結びついていく。句読点を最小限に抑えた詩のような文体で、現代イギリス社会における人種・ジェンダー・アイデンティティの多様性を描いた作品。
theme_summary_en: An ensemble novel linking together the lives of twelve Black and non-white British women, each given her own self-contained chapter. Spanning different generations, sexual orientations, and occupations, their stories are loosely connected through family ties and friendships. Written in a poetic style with minimal punctuation, the novel portrays the diversity of race, gender, and identity in contemporary British society.

author_ja: ダグラス・スチュアート
country: イギリス(スコットランド)/アメリカ
theme_summary_ja: 1980年代、経済的に疲弊したグラスゴーを舞台に、アルコール依存症の母アグネスと、それでも母を見捨てられない末息子シュギーの物語。周囲から浮いた存在として孤立するシュギーが、母の依存症と自らの性自認に対する周囲の視線という二重の困難を抱えながら成長していく様子が描かれる。作者自身の生い立ちを色濃く反映した、貧困と愛情、依存症をめぐる作品。
theme_summary_en: Set in economically devastated 1980s Glasgow, the novel follows Agnes, an alcoholic mother, and her youngest son Shuggie, who cannot bring himself to abandon her. Isolated as an outsider among his peers, Shuggie grows up shouldering the double burden of his mother's addiction and the scrutiny others direct at his own emerging sense of sexual identity. A work steeped in the author's own upbringing, concerned with poverty, love, and addiction.

author_ja: デイモン・ガルガット
theme_summary_ja: 南アフリカの白人一家スワート家の四人の兄弟姉妹を、アパルトヘイト末期から現代に至るまで、家族に起きる四つの葬儀を軸に描く物語。母の臨終の際に交わされた、長年住み込みで働いてきた黒人女性に土地を与えるという「約束」が、幾度となく先延ばしにされていく様が描かれる。ひとつの家族の衰退を通じて、南アフリカ社会の変容と未解決のまま残された人種問題を映し出す作品。
theme_summary_en: Following the four siblings of the white South African Swart family from the last days of apartheid to the present, the novel is structured around four family funerals. At the center is a "promise" made at their mother's deathbed to give a house to Salome, the Black woman who has worked for the family for years as domestic help -- a promise that is repeatedly deferred and broken. Through the decline of a single family, the novel reflects the transformation of South African society and its still-unresolved racial reckoning.

author_ja: シェハン・カルナティラカ
work_ja: マーリ・アルメイダの七つの月
work_original: The Seven Moons of Maali Almeida

jp_translation.title_ja: マーリ・アルメイダの七つの月

theme_summary_ja: 1990年代、内戦下のスリランカで殺害された写真家マーリ・アルメイダの霊が、自らを殺した犯人を突き止めるため、死後7つの月というタイムリミットの中を彷徨う物語。生前隠していた写真と、紛争の当事者たちの暴力の記録が、あの世とこの世を行き来しながら明らかにされていく。内戦の残虐さをブラックユーモアを交えた幻想的な設定で描いた作品。
theme_summary_en: In 1990s civil-war Sri Lanka, the ghost of Maali Almeida, a photographer who has been murdered, wanders the afterlife with only seven moons to identify his killer before his time runs out. As he moves between the world of the dead and the world of the living, the photographs he hid in life -- records of the violence committed by all sides of the conflict -- are gradually brought to light. A novel that depicts the brutality of the civil war through a fantastical premise laced with dark humor.

author_ja: ポール・リンチ

jp_translation.note: 受賞から邦訳刊行まで約2年半のタイムラグがある

theme_summary_ja: 近未来のアイルランドで、全体主義的な政権が突如として国を掌握し、市民生活が急速に統制されていく中、政治犯として連行された夫を持つ母親アイリンが家族を守ろうと奮闘する物語。日常が少しずつ、しかし後戻りできないほど暴力的な監視社会へと変貌していく過程が、切迫した文体で描かれる。西欧の「安全な国」で起こりうる崩壊を描いたディストピア小説。
theme_summary_en: In a near-future Ireland, a totalitarian government suddenly seizes control of the country, and as civic life is rapidly brought under strict control, a mother named Eilish struggles to protect her family after her husband is taken away as a political prisoner. Written in an urgent, breathless style, the novel traces how ordinary life is transformed, gradually but irreversibly, into a violent surveillance state. A dystopian novel that imagines a collapse that could happen even within a "safe" Western nation.

author_ja: サマンサ・ハーヴィー
work_ja: オービタル ある一日の16回の夜明け

jp_translation.title_ja: オービタル ある一日の16回の夜明け
jp_translation.note: 受賞から邦訳刊行まで約1年半のタイムラグがある
jp_translation.note_en: There is a lag of roughly a year and a half between the award and the publication of the Japanese translation.

theme_summary_ja: 国際宇宙ステーションに滞在する6人の宇宙飛行士たちが過ごす、地球を16周する一日を描く物語。眼下を流れていく大陸や海、昼夜の反復を眺めながら、それぞれが地球に残してきた家族や人生について思いを巡らせる。壮大な宇宙的視点と地上に生きる人間としての小さな感情とを対比させながら、生命や地球の美しさを静かに見つめた作品。
theme_summary_en: The novel follows a single day -- sixteen orbits of the Earth -- in the lives of six astronauts aboard the International Space Station. Watching the continents and oceans stream by beneath them, and the endless repetition of day and night, each astronaut turns their thoughts to the family and life they left behind on Earth. Setting a vast cosmic perspective against the small, human emotions of those who live below, the novel quietly contemplates the beauty of life and of the planet itself.

author_ja: デイヴィッド・サライ

jp_translation.note: 2025年11月受賞のため邦訳はまだ刊行されていないとみられる(2026年時点)

notes: カナダ生まれ、ハンガリー系。「ハンガリー系イギリス人作家」と紹介されることが多い
theme_summary_ja: ハンガリーの労働者階級出身の少年イシュトヴァーンが、思春期から老年に至るまでの人生を、簡潔で感情を抑えた文体で追う物語。年上の女性との関係、軍隊での経験、そしてイギリスへの移住を経て富や地位を得ていく一方で、彼は自らの内面や感情をほとんど言葉にしないまま人生の節目を通り過ぎていく。一人の男の人生を通じて、階級移動と男性性、身体の生々しさを描いた作品。
notes_en: Born in Canada, of Hungarian descent. Often introduced as a "Hungarian-British writer."
theme_summary_en: Written in spare, emotionally restrained prose, the novel follows the life of Istvan, a working-class Hungarian boy, from adolescence into old age. Through a relationship with an older woman, his military service, and eventual emigration to England, he gains wealth and status, yet passes through each milestone of his life almost without ever putting his inner feelings into words. Through the life of a single man, the novel depicts class mobility, masculinity, and the raw physicality of the body.
